camera-space oriented geometric direction, host buffer xyz; not RGB/rendered normal

limitations: The observed images are training views of the frozen original model; view2 is held out from the local solver only. No GT reconstruction metric or Gaussian parameter backpropagation. Host warp_patch_ncc uses squared signed correlation and a 5e-6 variance gate, whereas this probe uses signed 1-ZNCC on grayscale with variance >1e-8; native, photo and joint are compared under this same probe metric. Local image derivatives are valid only inside the active bilinear cells; points within 1e-6 pixel of a cell edge are rejected. Implicit-solution derivatives are checked locally for one recorded member xi perturbation on each accepted isolated positive-Hessian branch; this is not full Gaussian backpropagation. All 32 rays remain in coverage and fallback counts. Means and medians use only the fixed native view2-valid index set (29/32 scan37; 24/32 scan40), locked before candidate outcomes; each candidate must have a cost at every one of those indices.
